mapper.update: MERGE INTO auth_user_credential t USING (SELECT #{userId} AS user_id, #{passwordHash} AS password_hash) s ON (t.user_id = s.user_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET password_hash=s.password_hash,password_changed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, login_failures=0,locked_until=NULL,session_version=t.session_version+1 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (user_id,password_hash,password_changed_at,login_failures,locked_until,session_version) VALUES (s.user_id,s.password_hash,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,0,NULL,0)
UPDATE auth_user_credential SET login_failures=#{loginFailures}, locked_until=#{lockedUntil} WHERE user_id=#{userId}
